title: LicenseScanReport
description: Cross-stack dependency-license inventory + allowlist evaluation, produced by bin/license-scan.sh. Rows come from the per-stack collectors under bin/license-tools/ (each soft-skipping when its manifest or ecosystem CLI is absent — tools_skipped records which). An allowlist nudge, not an SCA product: violations are advisory findings carried by the opt-in license-allowlist guard and doctor's informational LICENSES section, never a block.

scanned.description: True when at least one collector produced rows. False + enabled means no ecosystem tool was applicable/installed.

reason.description: not-allowlisted = a declared license outside the allowlist; unknown-license = the tool could not determine one (never guessed).
